label: Air cooler

questions.text: How often is the water in the tank changed?
questions.why: Stale water smells and leaves deposits.

questions.text: When were the cooling pads last cleaned or replaced?
questions.why: Dirty pads cool less and smell.

questions.text: Is the tank emptied and dried before storing it for winter?
questions.why: Water left in the tank causes smells and damage.

questions.text: Does the power at home often dip, flicker or trip?
questions.why: Unsteady power can damage the electronics.
Coolers work best with fresh air coming in.

questions.text: Have you noticed weak air, a smell, leaks or pump noise?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off and unplug the cooler before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning an appliance that is plugged in risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the cooler yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Change the tank water often and use clean water.
care_tips.why: Stale water smells and leaves deposits.

care_tips.text: Clean or replace the cooling pads as the manual suggests.
Empty and dry the tank before storing the cooler.
care_tips.why: Water left inside causes smells and damage.

care_tips.text: Place the cooler near an open window or door.
care_tips.why: Coolers need fresh air to cool well.

care_tips.text: Don't run the pump when the tank is empty.
care_tips.why: Running dry can damage the pump.

care_tips.text: If it leaks or the pump gets noisy, switch it off and contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: A failing pump can stop the cooling.

reminders.text: Empty and clean the cooler's water tank.
reminders.interval_text: about once a week in summer
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.
